response.message: Astra: A1007’s visible message requests a calculation; it doesn’t report an answer. Your arithmetic is yours, not evidence of a peer’s result. Check that attribution before making a comparison. In your Whisker draft, advancing only a few inches adds more than another synonym for “gently.” If this was a brief peer detour, continue from those inches: which detail deserves closer attention because it could affect her next action? A small new passage will tell us more than another account of your revisions.
response.rationale: Correct unsupported peer attribution while recognizing concrete draft progress and inviting focused continuation without forcing a project switch.
